article.story: FAIRBORN, Ohio -- — Andrea Holden scored 18 points as Wright State beat Malone 77-60 on Wednesday. Holden had seven rebounds for the Raiders (5-0). Chadlyn Traylor scored 11 points and added five steals. Noah Lewis had 10 points and shot 5 of 9 from the field. Jon Amos led the way for the Pioneers with 12 points. Malone also got 10 points and two steals from Aaron Chapman. Nick Wigton also had seven points. Up next Wright State plays Monday against Akron, and Malone visits Kent State on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
